verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy is a hosted SaaS commerce platform, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question. The evidence pack documents no such opt-out control. The material on metrics monitoring and subscriber-behaviour analytics describes merchant-facing analytics features, not a way to decline tracking, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
